achievements.name: Relax
achievements.description: You've tasted the tea of sweet Chall Bark.

achievements.name: Strong
achievements.description: You’ve tasted the tea of bitter Podla Berries.

achievements.name: Sweet
achievements.description: You've tasted the strange, spicy tea of Coyala Flowers.

achievements.name: Cat Lover
achievements.description: You've Jellicly petted a Jellicle Lomri.

achievements.name: Dead End
achievements.description: In all the tea houses, in all the spaceports, you've walked up to this one.

achievements.name: Literate
achievements.description: Once there was an ugly Master. He was so ugly that everyone died. The End!

achievements.name: The Trimmer
achievements.description: Your slow blade penetrated the Podla's shields.

achievements.name: Mechanical failure
achievements.description: You've cranked the Windmill up to eleven.

achievements.name: Top Gun
achievements.description: You've felt the need -- the need for speed!

achievements.name: Star Destroyer
achievements.description: You've asked the computer to never tells you the odds.

achievements.name: Gunslinger
achievements.description: You made sure the robots said hello to your little friend.

achievements.name: Home Sweet Home
achievements.description: You've purchased every trinket, gadget, and knick-knack for sale. Buy! Consume! Obey!

achievements.name: God of creation
achievements.description: You've seen things people wouldn't believe, universes created in the palm of her hand...

achievements.name: God of destruction
achievements.description: You wonder how many universes like this have been lost, like tears in rain.

achievements.name: Aspiring God of Creation
achievements.description: Mama always said life was like a box of Universes. You never know what you're gonna get.

achievements.name: Again!
achievements.description: Seven, eight, clean your game. Nine, ten, start over again!
